Messages.Author: Cult Fiction Comics
Messages.Body:
I was thinking of attending DragonCon this year and wondered what kind of
attendance the Vampire games received in 99. I see that they had a Sabbat
Sealed event and the Dragons Breath tourney and wondered how many people
they got for each. Were there any other side events or games for Vtes? Did
any of the dealers sell any Vampire cards/singles or whatever?

Mike Buckley

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Sabbat Sealed (which was a bring-your-own affair in 1999) attracted
24 players. The Dragons Breath tourney (a regular constructed-deck
tournament) attracted 19 players. There were no other "official" or
scheduled V:TES events in 1999, but, of course, there were many
pick-up games.

--
LSJ (vte...@wizards.com) V:TES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and tournament rules:
http://www.wizards.com/VTES/rules.asp

Card sales availablity was moderate, but present. You had to get to the
dealer's room on the first two days. After that, most everyone had ferreted
out the deals, and all that was left was packs at full retail (yes, even
Sabbat, which was there on day 4).
From what people I know are saying, this year will be larger (extra 3-5
people from Charlotte, extra 2 people from Boston, possibly)... Hope to see
you there

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Mike wrote:
>>How many people are going to Origins this year? I will be playing in all the
Vampire events there hopefully. How about GenCon? Which one is better to go
to for Vampire tourneys?>>

Well, I'm probably going to Origins. Last year, among others, were myself,
Raille, Josh Duffin, and James Hamblin. There were two tournaments, one with
about 16 players and one with about 10, and I ended up running them both (and
playing as well--we had sort of a Judges Triumverate, but it never really
became an issue), as Wizards didn't really have a judge for them. The tournies
were fun, and there were a lot of prizes--everyone got stuff just for showing
up.

There was some sort of sealed/draft event, but I only think about 3 or 4 people
played that (and I wasn't one of them, so I don't really know...)

Peter D Bakija
